history.change: Use a self-contained SmallResNet with lazy PIL decoding, BCEWithLogitsLoss using bounded per-attribute positive weighting, tune-only target-aligned checkpoint selection, global threshold search over 0.02..0.50, deterministic artifact reload, and argmax fallback for empty predictions. No pretrained weights or external assets are used.

Retain the validated self-contained residual CNN and target-aligned tune checkpointing, while adding prevalence-aware initialization of the 3474 output biases and enforcing two-dimensional label matrices without reshape-based flattening. The output bias is initialized to the smoothed per-attribute logit prevalence, improving early calibration for highly imbalanced attributes while preserving the bounded square-root positive weighting. The candidate remains image-only, lazily decodes images, performs tune-only global threshold selection, records the actual convergence trajectory, and supports deterministic fresh-process reload.
